findings.desc: done_closure can report canAttemptDone=true and authorityServerPath.required=false from local DONE oracle rows even though story_advance DONE also runs runAuthorityReceiptTransitionGate and blocks in Authority enforce mode without a verified production receipt. This under-reports the Authority Server path instead of projecting the same real DONE closure boundary; the runbook should include the Authority receipt gate status/next command and avoid canAttemptDone=true for the full DONE attempt when enforce-mode receipt consumption would fail.

packages/main/src/handlers/done-closure.ts:121 and :129-133 compute canAttemptDone and authorityServerPath without checking Authority mode or receipt eligibility. In Authority enforce mode, packages/main/src/handlers/phase-gates.ts:347-405 can still block TEST/DONE on consumeAuthorityGateReceiptDocument, so done_closure can report local blockers clear, required=false, receiptVerified=false instead of the required Authority receipt path. This violates docs/requirements/decisions/done-closure-runbook-assistant-execution-plan.md:261-287, which requires the runbook to reflect the story_advance DONE pre-check and keep receiptVerified tied to verified receipts. Severity high because the assistant can mislead agents about DONE closure in Authority mode, even though the underlying gate still blocks.
